title: Close inherited stdin in provider auth probes

reproduction.summary: All four endpoints of second OpenAI CLI provider account (codex2) reported unavailable with detail 'Reading additional input from stdin' while quota_reset_at (2026-09-13T09:31:00Z) had already passed.
reproduction.root_cause: common.run_command invoked subprocess.run with capture_output=True and text=True but no stdin parameter, leaving stdin=None. Child processes inherited supervisor standard input. When provider_permissions._codex_auth_probe invoked codex exec -C <root> ... <prompt>, the CLI detected unclosed stdin, printed 'Reading additional input from stdin...', and blocked waiting for input until probe timeout, incorrectly classifying the healthy account as an auth failure.

codex2_2.detail: Reading additional input from stdin... 2026-09-17T05:35:07.279177Z ERROR codex_login::auth::manager: Failed to refresh token: 401 Unauthorized...

codex2_4.detail: Reading additional input from stdin... 2026-09-17T04:46:57.081871Z ERROR codex_login::auth::manager: Failed to refresh token: 401 Unauthorized...

changes..orchestrator/common.py: Updated run_command to default stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL and accept optional stdin/input parameters.
changes..orchestrator/provider_permissions.py: Explicitly passed stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL to run_command across _codex_auth_probe, _claude_auth_status_payload, _antigravity_auth_probe, and gcloud ADC checks.
changes..orchestrator/test_common.py: Added RunCommandStdinIsolationTests verifying default DEVNULL behavior, closed stdin with parent pipe, and explicit stdin/input support. Isolated task-state event log environment variables in activity outbox integration test.
Added test_codex_auth_probe_closes_stdin_so_cli_blocking_on_inherited_stdin_succeeds in ProviderProbeGateTest proving that closed stdin allows a blocking CLI to succeed promptly and record healthy state, while unpatched probe reproduces timeout classification.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: 1. Reproduce first: all four endpoints of second OpenAI CLI provider account report unavailable with detail 'Reading additional input from stdin' while quota_reset_at (2026-09-13T09:31:00Z) has passed.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: Extracted delivery_health records from coordination-root state.json showing codex2 quota_reset_at 2026-09-13T09:31:00Z with all four endpoints (codex2_1..4) unavailable due to inherited stdin blocking in codex exec.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: 2. Close child stdin for every auth probe by passing subprocess.DEVNULL through run_command or probe call sites so no provider CLI can block on inherited input; keep prompt as argument.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: common.run_command now defaults stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL and provider_permissions._codex_auth_probe explicitly passes stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL with prompt unchanged as positional CLI argument.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: 3. Prove with isolated fake CLI that blocks on stdin when inherited and exits promptly when stdin is closed: probe must succeed within timeout and endpoint record become healthy; without change same fake reproduces timeout classification.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: test_codex_auth_probe_closes_stdin_so_cli_blocking_on_inherited_stdin_succeeds passed: with fix returns ready=True, status='ready' and endpoint state='healthy'; without fix times out and returns ready=False, status='probe_timeout'.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: 4. Keep every other probe fence unchanged: timeout, cache recovery retry, quota classification, and auth failure classification.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: All existing probe tests passed unchanged: quota_reached, refresh_token_revoked, auth_failed, models_cache_recovery, and probe_timeout.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: 5. Run focused and full-file regression for changed modules and record exact commands with exit codes and pass/fail counts.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: test_common.py: 138 tests passed (Ran 138 tests in 14.148s, OK); test_provider_permissions.py: 131 tests passed (Ran 131 tests in 68.663s, OK).

acceptance_matrix.criterion: 6. Source and isolated-test scope only. No credential changes and no live probe against production accounts under this task.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: Only .orchestrator/{common.py,test_common.py,provider_permissions.py,test_provider_permissions.py} and evidence manifest modified. Zero credentials modified.
